baseline.label: Built-in reward
baseline.blurb: The game's own scoring, untouched. The control.

timefee.label: Built-in + time fee
timefee.blurb: A charge of 0.03 per frame, so dawdling costs something. Still lands.

hacked.label: +3/frame for upright & slow
hacked.blurb: Sounds like what you want. Pays for being somewhere nice, so the rocket stops and collects.

fixed.label: The same idea, paid correctly
fixed.blurb: Pays the change in uprightness rather than the level, plus a time fee. Nothing to farm by waiting.
